entities.summary: Sadíqova Sara Ğarif qızı aka Sara Sadíqova (Sadıyqova); Tatar Cyrillic: Садыйкова Сара Гариф кызы; Russian: Сады́кова Сара́ Гари́фовна; 1 November 1906 – 7 June 1986) was a Tatar actress, singer (soprano), and composer. From 1938–1948 she was a soloist of Musa Cälil Tatar Opera and Ballet Theatre. Sara performed parts in operas and musical comedies including Saniä, Qaçqın (Runaway), Ğäliäbanu, Başmağım, İldar, musical dramas On Qandır, The Employer. She is the author of many song and musical comedies including Mäxäbbät cırı (1971), and Kiäwlär (Sons-in-law) (1972) in collaboration with R.
